When evaluating changes in hypertrophy-related measures over time, BIA shows somewhat mixed results. A high correlation was found between BIA and hydrodensitometry ( r = .92) when assessing changes in fat-free mass in a cohort of male athletes consuming creatine monohydrate over a 7-day loading period (48). Good agreement was demonstrated between multifrequency BIA and DXA ( r = .71) for lean mass changes in young men across a 10-week resistance training program; however, the two methods were poor predictors of each other
